_comment: MCP servers Agent Manager can reach. Editable from Settings and from Claude
(set_mcp_server), so this file is a seed rather than a hardcoded list.
One entry per server. Adobe ships these per product - Workfront, AEM, AEP -
and more will arrive. Adding one is an entry here, never a code change.
id        stable key, referenced by agents and by agent systems
practice  the domain it belongs to (workfront | aep | aem), or null
endpoint  base URL. Routes below it are resolved from the tool-name prefix
auth      an Authorization header value, or null when the server owns auth
active    false leaves it registered but unused
SECRETS: put a real token in the environment, not here. A value of the form
${ENV_VAR} is resolved from the environment at call time, so this file stays

servers.label: Adobe Experience Cloud MCP
notes: 238 tools. AEP, CJA, AJO, Target, Web SDK, plus AWS/Databricks/Snowflake.
Knowledge tool is `search_adobe_knowledge`. `search_knowledge_base` does NOT exist -
asking for it is why every grounding call has failed while reporting completed.
Agent 3's tools are all live here: adobe_create_segment_estimate,

servers.label: Workfront MCP (in-house)
notes: INACTIVE: the routes return HTTP 404 at this gateway. template.yaml in
chaunceyplum/mcp declares all eight (core, users, documents, time-approval,
metadata, search, comments, planning), so the deployed stack is behind the repo
or they sit behind another API. Flip active to true when they answer.
Tools: wf_core_*, wf_comments_*, wf_docs_*, wf_metadata_*, wf_search_*, wf_planning_*.

servers.label: Workfront MCP (Adobe official)
notes: Adobe's own connector. OAuth 2.0 as the signed-in user, or a service-to-service
token from the Developer Console. Needs the `wf-url` header to pick the instance.
Write tools are OFF by default on a tenant - a Workfront admin enables them.
Set WORKFRONT_TOKEN in the environment and flip active to true.

servers.label: AEM MCP
notes: Declared so the domain has a home. No endpoint yet.
